synopsis: Star Wars: The Mandalorian Collection A lavishly illustrated celebration of the Star Wars including interviews and features exploring all facets of the saga. A deluxe collector's hardcover edition exploring the Star Wars saga on with features and interviews covering the first appearance of Boba Fett in the infamous Star Wars Holiday Special, the Droids and Ewoks cartoons - through to The Clone Wars and Star Wars Rebels and up to the present day - The Mandalorian, The Book of Boba Fett, and Obi-Wan Kenobi.
